title: works well, but is VERY sharp edged.
text: works well, but is VERY sharp edged.. I actually purchased two scoops.  This one and the rounder, softer edged aluminum one. The rounder edged one is huge.  And I have smaller popcorn bags, so despite the reviews that reported this one as super sharp edged, I decided to try it...  It arrived in good shape and quickly (I have prime).  It has a "protective film" on the inside that took quite a lot of effort to remove, but I finally prevailed.  It peeled off successfully.  It is drilled on both sides, so you could make it a leftie or a rightie server which is nice. The wholes drilled in it are to help the unpopped kernals to fall through and reduce the number in your served bags.  This one fits nicely into the the smaller bags and loads well.  The edges ARE VERY sharp. But I don't spend time rubbing my fingers down the edges, so I'm ok with that.  It would be nice if they would soften the edges some, thus minus 1 star.  While this is stainless steel, I hand wash it, carefully (sharp edges) because of the handle.  I suppose you could unscrew the handle and throw it in the dishwasher, but eventually you'd probably strip the screw, so I would not recommend that.  All in all, it works very well when you consider handling it properly.  Unless you are allowing very small children to fill the bags, I think it's worth a shot.

product_metadata.title: Paragon - Manufactured Fun Stainless Steel Popcorn Scoop
description: This scoop is ideal for any size popcorn machine. The perfect scoop to quickly fill bags and buckets with fresh popcorn when using the Paragon 1042 large popcorn scoop! This durable stainless steel scoop features an easy-to-assemble handle and it can be configured to use as either a left or right hand operation. Perfect for concession stands, events or even home use. It even features holes to sift out popcorn kernels so the kernels do not make it into the popcorn bags.
